description: This file defines the TraceModel class and related types and functions for managing and analyzing trace data in Playwright. It includes methods for constructing action trees, filtering actions, collecting source code information, and handling timing adjustments between library and test runner contexts.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: Represents a comprehensive model of a trace, including actions, events, sources, and timing information, with methods for analysis and filtering.

methods.name: indexModel
methods.description: Indexes context entries by associating pages, actions, events, and resources with their context.

methods.name: mergeActionsAndUpdateTiming
methods.description: Merges actions from multiple contexts and updates their timing information, establishing parent-child relationships.

methods.name: buildActionTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical tree of actions based on parent-child relationships.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Retrieves the context entry associated with a given action, event, or resource.

methods.name: nextInContext
methods.description: Gets the next action in the same context.

methods.name: previousActionByEndTime
methods.description: Gets the previous action based on end time.

methods.name: nextActionByStartTime
methods.description: Gets the next action based on start time.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates error and warning counts for a given action.

methods.name: eventsForAction
methods.description: Retrieves events associated with a specific action.

methods.name: collectSources
methods.description: Collects source code snippets and error information related to actions and stack frames.
